acquiredBy: manual download by project owner from the official ICMR-NIN website
machineReadableNote: ICMR-NIN publishes IFCT 2017 as a book only. No CSV, XLSX, JSON, or API is offered on nin.res.in — ifct_book.html and IFCT_concisecopy.html link no data file. The domain ifct2017.com no longer belongs to the project and now redirects to unrelated commercial sites; it must not be used.

encryption.note: The publisher applied a technical protection measure that explicitly denies text extraction. The accessibility flag is a narrow carve-out for assistive technology serving a person with a disability; it is not a licence to bulk-harvest 585 pages of tables into a product database.

copyrightNotice: ICMR-National Institute of Nutrition © 2018, All Rights Reserved. The site states: "All rights reserved for this website. No part of this website may..."
developmentUsageNote: The document may be read by a person, and used to verify mappings or spot-check values obtained elsewhere. It is not a data source for automated extraction.
importBlocker: The only official artefact is a copyrighted PDF whose owner permissions deny text extraction. Vyom will not circumvent that. Automated import requires either a dataset supplied by ICMR-NIN or written permission covering extraction and redistribution.
nextAction: Request the underlying dataset and written permission from ICMR-NIN, covering (a) extraction of composition values, (b) storage in a database, (c) display to practitioners within a commercial SaaS product, and (d) required attribution wording.
notes: File size and checksum match the official download exactly, so the copy held locally is authentic and unmodified.
A later revision exists at https://www.nin.res.in/ebooks/IFCT2017_16122024.pdf (12,405,852 bytes, dated 16-12-2024). Not acquired.
Third-party reproductions exist on GitHub, Kaggle, Scribd and academia.edu. None is authoritative and none may be used — see docs/nutrition-data.md.
